Farm-ING makes spot sprayer smaller

 29-09 | Smart farming | News

LinkedInFacebookXWhatsAppPrint

The Austrian manufacturer Farm-ING is launching 2 smaller SpotSprayING models, with working widths of 2.5 to 3 metres and 4.5 metres. Photo: Farm-ING

Austrian manufacturer Farm-ING is expanding its SpotSprayING range with 2 smaller versions. The machines have working widths of 2.5 to 3 metres and 4.5 metres and are intended for arable farmers who want to carry out spot spraying themselves.

According to importer Farmstore, demand for smaller machines came partly from farmers who do not need a large spot sprayer. Having their own machine means they are not dependent on a contractor when it comes to spraying timing.

Cameras every 75 centimetres

The new versions use the same camera technology as the larger models with working widths of 6 to 12 metres. A camera is positioned every 75 cm and distinguishes between crops and weeds. The spray nozzles are spaced 5 cm apart and are controlled individually. The smallest spot size is 55 by 55 mm.

Demand for smaller machines

According to Chris van de Lindeloof, sales & marketing manager at Farmstore, interest in smaller versions became apparent during the AgroTechniek Holland (ATH) agricultural machinery show. “We received quite a few enquiries about small machines”, a large spot sprayer can easily cost €150,000 to €200,000, he says, and requires a large number of hectares to justify the investment. “A small machine can be good enough for a farmer who only wants to spray his own land.”

No longer dependent on a contractor

Van de Lindeloof does not specify a minimum number of hectares. According to him, savings on crop protection products can be expressed in euros, but this does not apply to all the effects of spot spraying. Having their own machine also makes the grower less dependent on the contractor’s schedule. “You can more easily go out earlier or make an extra pass.”

Available from €80,000

The new models launched by Farm-ING are available immediately through importer Farmstore. The 3-metre version is available from €80,000. No final price has yet been set for the 4.5-metre version. Van de Lindeloof expects it to cost about 1.5 times as much, or approximately €120,000. 1 unit of the 3-metre version has already been sold.

translationZh:
奥地利制造商Farm-ING正在扩展其SpotSprayING产品系列，新增2款更小型版本。这两款机器的工作幅宽分别为2.5至3米和4.5米，面向希望自行进行精准喷雾的耕地农民。

据进口商Farmstore称，对更小型机器的需求部分来自那些不需要大型精准喷雾机的农民。拥有自己的机器意味着在喷雾时机上不再依赖承包商。

**每75厘米布置一个摄像头**

新版本采用与工作幅宽6至12米的大型机型相同的摄像头技术。每75厘米布置一个摄像头，用于区分作物与杂草。喷嘴间距为5厘米，并可单独控制。最小喷雾点尺寸为55×55毫米。

**对更小型机器的需求**

据Farmstore销售与市场经理Chris van de Lindeloof称，在AgroTechniek Holland（ATH）农业机械展上，人们对更小型版本的兴趣变得明显。“我们收到了不少关于小型机器的咨询。”他说，一台大型精准喷雾机的价格很容易达到15万至20万欧元，并且需要大量公顷数才能证明投资合理。“对于只想喷洒自己土地的农民来说，一台小型机器可能就足够了。”

**不再依赖承包商**

Van de Lindeloof没有说明最低公顷数。据他称，作物保护产品的节省可以用欧元来表示，但这并不适用于精准喷雾的所有效果。拥有自己的机器也使种植者更少依赖承包商的时间安排。“你可以更容易地提前作业或额外进行一次喷施。”

**8万欧元起售**

Farm-ING推出的新机型可立即通过进口商Farmstore购买。3米版本起售价为8万欧元。4.5米版本的最终价格尚未确定。Van de Lindeloof预计其价格约为前者的1.5倍，即约12万欧元。3米版本已有1台售出。
